subject.title: [codex] fix(feishu): preserve post markdown line breaks

question: Which Feishu post-md newline branch should be kept as the canonical fix after conflicts and proof gaps are resolved?
rationale: Several open PRs target the same Feishu newline bug, this branch has a source-level ordering defect and no live proof, and the currently proof-positive sibling is conflicting rather than immediately landable.

options.title: Favor the proof-positive sibling after conflict repair
options.body: Use the branch with Feishu screenshot proof and safer table/card ordering as the likely canonical path once its conflicts are resolved.

options.title: Keep this draft as the candidate
options.body: Require this branch to move normalization after raw card/table routing, resolve conflicts, and add redacted live Feishu proof before another merge review.

options.title: Hold only the linked bug open
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open while maintainers close or pause duplicate PRs after choosing one branch to carry the fix.

recommendation.title: Favor the proof-positive sibling after conflict repair
recommendation.body: Use the branch with Feishu screenshot proof and safer table/card ordering as the likely canonical path once its conflicts are resolved.
